_about: Public-domain Adrian Fortescue (1874-1923, Letchworth priest, liturgist and Eastern-Church historian) for the Word Hoard: The Orthodox Eastern Church (1907), The Greek Fathers (1908), The Mass: a Study of the Roman Liturgy (1912), The Lesser Eastern Churches (1913), Donatism (1917) and The Ceremonies of the Roman Rite Described (1918), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 33 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

fortescue-orthodox-eastern-church: The Orthodox Eastern Church (London: Catholic Truth Society, 1907)
fortescue-greek-fathers: The Greek Fathers (London: Catholic Truth Society; St. Louis: B. Herder, 1908)
fortescue-the-mass: The Mass: a Study of the Roman Liturgy (London: Longmans, Green, 1912)
fortescue-lesser-eastern-churches: The Lesser Eastern Churches (London: Catholic Truth Society; title page undated, preface 1913)
fortescue-ceremonies-roman-rite: The Ceremonies of the Roman Rite Described (London: Burns & Oates, MCMXVIII)

_alternates.fortescue-copies: The 1917 new impression of The Mass; the 1920 Ceremonies revised for the Code of Canon Law; other copies

_excluded.fortescue-later: The Uniate Eastern Churches in a 1957 printing catalogued 1923; Ignatius Press reprints; the memoir of him; single encyclopedia articles

_pending.fortescue-unfound: Latin Hymns (1913), The Early Papacy (1920) and the 1923 Uniate Eastern Churches: no scan found
